items.source: 1 publicMethod matches if a method execution join point represents the execution of any public method. 2 inTrading matches if a method execution is in the trading module. 3 tradingOperation matches if a method execution represents any public method in the trading module.
items.translation: 1 publicMethod 匹配任何公共方法的执行连接点。 2 inTrading 匹配在交易模块中的方法执行。 3 tradingOperation 匹配交易模块中任何公共方法的方法执行。

items.source: The full AspectJ pointcut language supports additional pointcut designators that are not supported in Spring: call, get, set, preinitialization, staticinitialization, initialization, handler, adviceexecution, withincode, cflow, cflowbelow, if, @this, and @withincode. Use of these pointcut designators in pointcut expressions interpreted by Spring AOP results in an IllegalArgumentException being thrown.
items.translation: 完整的 AspectJ 点切面语言支持 Spring 不支持的额外点切面设计符：call、get、set、preinitialization、staticinitialization、initialization、handler、adviceexecution、withincode、cflow、cflowbelow、if、@this 和 @withincode。在 Spring AOP 解释的点切面表达式中使用这些点切面设计符会导致抛出 IllegalArgumentException。

items.source: All parts except the returning type pattern (ret-type-pattern in the preceding snippet), the name pattern, and the parameters pattern are optional. The returning type pattern determines what the return type of the method must be in order for a join point to be matched. * is most frequently used as the returning type pattern. It matches any return type. A fully-qualified type name matches only when the method returns the given type. The name pattern matches the method name. You can use the * wildcard as all or part of a name pattern. If you specify a declaring type pattern, include a trailing . to join it to the name pattern component. The parameters pattern is slightly more complex: () matches a method that takes no parameters, whereas (..) matches any number (zero or more) of parameters. The (*) pattern matches a method that takes one parameter of any type. (*,String) matches a method that takes two parameters. The first can be of any type, while the second must be a String. Consult the Language Semantics section of the AspectJ Programming Guide for more information.
items.translation: 除了返回类型模式（前例中的ret-type-pattern）、名称模式和参数模式外，其余部分均为可选。返回类型模式决定了方法必须具有何种返回类型才能匹配连接点。*最常用作返回类型模式，它匹配任何返回类型。完全限定的类型名仅当方法返回该给定类型时才匹配。名称模式匹配方法名。您可以使用*通配符作为名称模式的全部或部分。如果指定了声明类型模式，请在末尾包含一个.将其与名称模式组件连接起来。参数模式稍显复杂：()匹配不接受任何参数的方法，而(..)匹配任意数量（零个或多个）的参数。(*)模式匹配接受一个任意类型参数的方法。(*,String)匹配接受两个参数的方法：第一个可以是任意类型，而第二个必须是String。有关更多信息，请参阅 AspectJ 编程指南中的语言语义部分。

items.source: The idOrNameOfBean token can be the name of any Spring bean. Limited wildcard support that uses the * character is provided, so, if you establish some naming conventions for your Spring beans, you can write a bean PCD expression to select them. As is the case with other pointcut designators, the bean PCD can be used with the && (and), || (or), and ! (negation) operators, too.
items.translation: idOrNameOfBean 标记可以是任何 Spring Bean 的名称。提供了使用 * 字符的有限通配符支持，因此，如果您为 Spring Bean 建立了一些命名约定，则可以编写一个 bean PCD 表达式来选择它们。与其他切入点设计器一样，bean PCD 也可以与 &&（与）、||（或）和 !（否定）运算符一起使用。

items.source: The pointcut expression that forms the value of the @Pointcut annotation is a regular AspectJ pointcut expression. For a full discussion of AspectJ’s pointcut language, see the AspectJ Programming Guide (and, for extensions, the AspectJ 5 Developer’s Notebook) or one of the books on AspectJ (such as Eclipse AspectJ, by Colyer et al., or AspectJ in Action, by Ramnivas Laddad).
items.translation: `@Pointcut` 注解的值由一个点切面表达式形成，该表达式是标准的 AspectJ 点切面表达式。关于 AspectJ 点切面语言的完整讨论，请参阅 AspectJ 编程指南（以及关于扩展内容的 AspectJ 5 开发者笔记），或者 AspectJ 的相关书籍（例如 Colyer 等人著的 Eclipse AspectJ，或 Ramnivas Laddad 著的 AspectJ in Action）。

items.source: Kinded designators select a particular kind of join point: execution, get, set, call, and handler.
items.translation: Kinded 设计符选择特定类型的连接点：execution、get、set、call 和 handler。

items.source: Because Spring AOP limits matching to only method execution join points, the preceding discussion of the pointcut designators gives a narrower definition than you can find in the AspectJ programming guide. In addition, AspectJ itself has type-based semantics and, at an execution join point, both this and target refer to the same object: the object executing the method. Spring AOP is a proxy-based system and differentiates between the proxy object itself (which is bound to this) and the target object behind the proxy (which is bound to target).
items.translation: 由于 Spring AOP 将匹配范围限制为仅方法执行连接点，前述关于切入点设计符的讨论给出的定义比 AspectJ 编程指南中的定义更窄。此外，AspectJ 本身具有基于类型的语义，在执行连接点处，this和target都指向同一个对象：即正在执行该方法的对象。Spring AOP 是一个基于代理的系统，它区分代理对象本身（绑定到this）和代理背后的目标对象（绑定到target）。

items.source: It is a best practice to build more complex pointcut expressions out of smaller named pointcuts, as shown above. When referring to pointcuts by name, normal Java visibility rules apply (you can see private pointcuts in the same type, protected pointcuts in the hierarchy, public pointcuts anywhere, and so on). Visibility does not affect pointcut matching.

items.source: Contextual designators match (and optionally bind) based on context: this, target, and @annotation
items.translation: 上下文设计符根据上下文进行匹配（并可选地绑定）：this、target 和 @annotation。

items.source: Pointcuts determine join points of interest and thus enable us to control when advice runs. Spring AOP only supports method execution join points for Spring beans, so you can think of a pointcut as matching the execution of methods on Spring beans. A pointcut declaration has two parts: a signature comprising a name and any parameters and a pointcut expression that determines exactly which method executions we are interested in. In the @AspectJ annotation-style of AOP, a pointcut signature is provided by a regular method definition, and the pointcut expression is indicated by using the @Pointcut annotation (the method serving as the pointcut signature must have a void return type).
items.translation: 切面点用于确定感兴趣的连接点，从而使我们能够控制何时执行通知。Spring AOP 仅支持 Spring bean 的方法执行连接点，因此您可以将切面点视为匹配在 Spring bean 上方法执行的执行。切面点声明包含两部分：一个由名称和任何参数组成的签名，以及一个确定我们确切感兴趣哪些方法执行的切面点表达式。在 @AspectJ 注解风格的 AOP 中，切面点签名由常规方法定义提供，而切面点表达式通过使用 @Pointcut 注解来指示（作为切面点签名的方法必须具有 void 返回类型）。

items.source: Scoping designators select a group of join points of interest (probably of many kinds): within and withincode
items.translation: 作用域设计符用于选择一组感兴趣的重入点（可能包含多种类型）：within 和 withincode。

items.source: execution: For matching method execution join points. This is the primary pointcut designator to use when working with Spring AOP.
items.translation: execution：用于匹配方法执行连接点。这是在使用 Spring AOP 时应使用的主要切入点设计符。

items.source: within: Limits matching to join points within certain types (the execution of a method declared within a matching type when using Spring AOP).
items.translation: within：将匹配限制在特定类型的连接点内（在使用 Spring AOP 时，指匹配类型中声明的方法的执行）。

items.source: this: Limits matching to join points (the execution of methods when using Spring AOP) where the bean reference (Spring AOP proxy) is an instance of the given type.
items.translation: this：将匹配限制为连接点（在使用 Spring AOP 时方法的执行），其中 Bean 引用（Spring AOP 代理）是指定类型的实例。

items.source: target: Limits matching to join points (the execution of methods when using Spring AOP) where the target object (application object being proxied) is an instance of the given type.
items.translation: target：将匹配限制为连接点（在使用 Spring AOP 时方法的执行），其中目标对象（被代理的应用程序对象）是指定类型的实例。

items.source: args: Limits matching to join points (the execution of methods when using Spring AOP) where the arguments are instances of the given types.
items.translation: args：将匹配限制为连接点（在使用 Spring AOP 时方法的执行），其参数是指定类型的实例。

items.source: @target: Limits matching to join points (the execution of methods when using Spring AOP) where the class of the executing object has an annotation of the given type.
items.translation: @target：将匹配限制为连接点（在使用 Spring AOP 时方法的执行），其中执行对象的类具有给定类型的注解。

items.source: @args: Limits matching to join points (the execution of methods when using Spring AOP) where the runtime type of the actual arguments passed have annotations of the given types.
items.translation: @args：将匹配限制为连接点（在使用 Spring AOP 时方法的执行），其中实际传递参数的运行时类型具有给定类型的注解。

items.source: @within: Limits matching to join points within types that have the given annotation (the execution of methods declared in types with the given annotation when using Spring AOP).
items.translation: @within：将匹配限制在具有给定注解的类型内的连接点（在使用 Spring AOP 时，即执行具有给定注解的类中声明的方法）。

items.source: @annotation: Limits matching to join points where the subject of the join point (the method being run in Spring AOP) has the given annotation.
items.translation: @annotation：将匹配限制在具有给定注解的切入点主体（Spring AOP 中正在运行的方法）所在的连接点上。

items.source: If your interception needs include method calls or even constructors within the target class, consider the use of Spring-driven native AspectJ weaving instead of Spring’s proxy-based AOP framework. This constitutes a different mode of AOP usage with different characteristics, so be sure to make yourself familiar with weaving before making a decision.
items.translation: 如果您的拦截需求包括目标类中的方法调用甚至构造函数，请考虑使用 Spring 驱动的 原生 AspectJ 织入，而不是基于代理的 Spring AOP 框架。这构成了 AOP 使用的不同模式，具有不同的特性，因此在做出决定之前，请务必熟悉织入技术。

items.source: The bean PCD operates at the instance level (building on the Spring bean name concept) rather than at the type level only (to which weaving-based AOP is limited). Instance-based pointcut designators are a special capability of Spring’s proxy-based AOP framework and its close integration with the Spring bean factory, where it is natural and straightforward to identify specific beans by name.
items.translation: bean PCD 在实例级别运行（基于 Spring bean 名称概念），而不仅仅局限于类型级别（基于织造的 AOP 仅限于此）。基于实例的点切面设计符是 Spring 代理式 AOP 框架的特殊功能，该框架与 Spring Bean 工厂紧密集成，在此环境中通过名称识别特定 bean 既自然又直接。

items.source:
The set of pointcut designators supported by Spring AOP may be extended in future
releases to support more of the AspectJ pointcut designators.
items.translation: Spring AOP 支持的点切面设计符集合可能会在未来的版本中扩展，以支持更多的 AspectJ 点切面设计符。

items.source:
Due to the proxy-based nature of Spring’s AOP framework, calls within the target object
are, by definition, not intercepted. For JDK proxies, only public interface method
calls on the proxy can be intercepted. With CGLIB, public and protected method calls on
the proxy are intercepted (and even package-visible methods, if necessary). However,
common interactions through proxies should always be designed through public signatures.
items.translation: 由于 Spring AOP 框架基于代理，目标对象内部的调用按定义不会被拦截。对于 JDK 代理，只有对代理的公共接口方法调用可以被拦截。使用 CGLIB 时，对代理的公共和受保护方法调用会被拦截（必要时甚至包括包可见方法）。然而，通过代理进行的常见交互应始终通过公共签名进行设计。

items.source:
Note that pointcut definitions are generally matched against any intercepted method.
If a pointcut is strictly meant to be public-only, even in a CGLIB proxy scenario with
potential non-public interactions through proxies, it needs to be defined accordingly.
items.translation: 注意，切面定义通常与任何拦截的方法进行匹配。如果切面严格限定为仅公开（public），即使在可能存在通过代理的非公开交互的 CGLIB 代理场景中，也需要相应地定义它。

items.source:
During compilation, AspectJ processes pointcuts in order to optimize matching
performance. Examining code and determining if each join point matches (statically or
dynamically) a given pointcut is a costly process. (A dynamic match means the match
cannot be fully determined from static analysis and that a test is placed in the code to
determine if there is an actual match when the code is running). On first encountering a
pointcut declaration, AspectJ rewrites it into an optimal form for the matching
process. What does this mean? Basically, pointcuts are rewritten in DNF (Disjunctive
Normal Form) and the components of the pointcut are sorted such that those components
that are cheaper to evaluate are checked first. This means you do not have to worry
about understanding the performance of various pointcut designators and may supply them
in any order in a pointcut declaration.
items.translation: 在编译期间，AspectJ 会按顺序处理切入点（pointcuts）以优化匹配性能。检查代码并确定每个连接点（join point）是否（静态地或动态地）匹配给定的切入点是一个耗时的过程。（动态匹配意味着无法仅通过静态分析完全确定匹配结果，因此需要在代码中放置测试，以便在代码运行时确定是否存在实际匹配）。首次遇到切入点声明时，AspectJ 会将其重写为适合匹配过程的最优形式。这意味着什么？基本上，切入点会被重写为析取范式（DNF, Disjunctive Normal Form），并且切入点的组件会被排序，使得成本较低的组件优先进行检查。这意味着您无需担心理解各种切入点设计符的性能，可以在切入点声明中以任意顺序提供它们。

items.source:
However, AspectJ can work only with what it is told. For optimal performance of
matching, you should think about what you are trying to achieve and narrow the search
space for matches as much as possible in the definition. The existing designators
naturally fall into one of three groups: kinded, scoping, and contextual:
items.translation: 然而，AspectJ 只能根据所告知的内容工作。为了获得最佳匹配性能，您应思考要实现的目标，并在定义中尽可能缩小匹配的搜索空间。现有的设计符自然地分为三类：种类限定符、作用域限定符和上下文限定符：

items.source:
A well written pointcut should include at least the first two types (kinded and
scoping). You can include the contextual designators to match based on
join point context or bind that context for use in the advice. Supplying only a
kinded designator or only a contextual designator works but could affect weaving
performance (time and memory used), due to extra processing and analysis. Scoping
designators are very fast to match, and using them means AspectJ can very quickly
dismiss groups of join points that should not be further processed. A good
pointcut should always include one if possible.
items.translation: 编写良好的切面点应至少包含前两种类型（即 kinded 和 scoping）。您可以包含上下文设计符以根据连接点上下文进行匹配，或将该上下文绑定以便在Advice中使用。仅提供 kinded 设计符或仅提供上下文设计符虽然可行，但由于需要额外的处理和解析，可能会影响织入性能（时间和内存使用）。Scoping 设计符的匹配速度非常快，使用它们意味着 AspectJ 可以非常迅速地排除不应进一步处理的一组连接点。如果可能的话，良好的切面点应始终包含一个 scoping 设计符。

items.source: You can also use @target in a binding form. See the Declaring Advice section for how to make the annotation object available in the advice body.

items.source: You can also use @within in a binding form. See the Declaring Advice section for how to make the annotation object available in the advice body.
items.translation: 在绑定形式中，您也可以使用 @within。有关如何在建议主体中使注解对象可用，请参阅声明建议部分。

items.source: You can also use @annotation in a binding form. See the Declaring Advice section for how to make the annotation object available in the advice body.
items.translation: 在绑定形式中也可以使用 @annotation。请参阅声明 Advice部分，以了解如何在 Advice 主体中提供注解对象。

items.source: You can also use @args in a binding form. See the Declaring Advice section how to make the annotation object(s) available in the advice body.
items.translation: 在绑定表单中也可以使用 @args。请参阅声明 Advice部分，了解如何在 Advice 主体中提供注解对象。
